title: I. H. S
html_source: Molly told Joyce earlier in the book that this stands for “I have sinned” or “I have suffered”: in reality, it is from the fact that the name Jesus, spelt “ΙΗΣΟΥΣ” in Greek capitals, has the abbreviations IHS.
